description: GitHub Pages forbids running an online business, e-commerce or commercial SaaS on free hosting.
message: GitHub Pages is not allowed as free hosting for an online business or commercial SaaS. Pick another host for a commercial project.

description: Render free web services spin down after 15 minutes without inbound traffic; a Discord gateway bot needs a persistent process.
message: Render free instances sleep after 15 minutes without inbound HTTP traffic. A gateway bot would go offline. Use an always-on host (VPS, self-hosting).

description: Cloud Functions are not available on the Spark plan.
message: Firebase Spark has no Cloud Functions. Server code must run elsewhere (Workers, Render, Netlify functions).

description: Gemini API free tier content is used to improve Google products.
message: On the Gemini free tier, content is used to improve Google products. Do not send sensitive or personal data; use a paid tier or a local model.

description: n8n Sustainable Use License limits use to internal business or non-commercial purposes.
message: n8n Community is fine for your own internal workflows, but you may not offer n8n itself to others as a commercial service.

description: Tailscale Personal is for non-commercial use.
message: Tailscale Personal is only for non-commercial use.
Open-Meteo free tier does not allow commercial use.

description: Supabase already includes Auth (50,000 MAU on Free).
message: Supabase already ships Auth with 50,000 MAU on Free. Clerk is optional here unless you want its prebuilt UI.

description: Free Supabase projects pause after 1 week of inactivity.
message: Free Supabase projects pause after 1 week of inactivity. Low-traffic always-on apps may need to be woken up.

description: Render free Postgres expires after 30 days.
message: If you rely on Render free Postgres: it expires 30 days after creation. Plan a migration or use Neon, Turso or Supabase.

description: D1 is accessed from Cloudflare Workers; both free quotas are on the same pricing page.
message: D1 and Workers share one Cloudflare account and free plan. Natural pair.

description: Deno Deploy sunset announced for April 2027.
message: Deno Deploy is announced to sunset in April 2027. Avoid it for anything long-lived.

description: Quick Tunnels are for testing and development only.
message: TryCloudflare quick tunnels are for testing only. For production, create a named tunnel with a Cloudflare account.

description: Solana public RPC endpoints are not intended for production applications.
message: The Solana public RPC is rate limited per IP and not meant for production. Use a provider (Helius free tier, for example) for anything always-on.

description: MapTiler Free is described for testing, prototypes, personal or non-commercial use.
message: MapTiler Free is meant for testing, prototypes, personal or non-commercial use. Plan a paid tier for a commercial launch.

description: GitLab.com shared runners require card verification.
message: Using GitLab.com shared runners requires card verification ($1 authorization, not charged). Your own runner avoids it.
